songs.title: Walk On
songs.notes:
House music from playback.
All vocal mics muted.

songs.title: Opener
songs.notes:
Unmute vox 1-3 on count-in.
Guitar solo at 2:10 -> +3 dB on GTR 1.

songs.title: Second Song
songs.notes:
Acoustic intro: only vox 1 + AC GTR.
Full band drops at verse 2.

songs.title: Ballad
songs.notes:
Long reverb on lead vox (FX 2).
Watch the keys - quiet pad, bring up.

songs.title: Closer
songs.notes:
Delay throw on last 'goodnight'.
Mute everything after final hit.
